text:
Picture a locksmith in Midland. Quiet phone.

His nephew reckons he needs to be dancing on TikTok.

Someone's locked out in Guildford at 9pm. Nobody opens TikTok to find a locksmith.

They type "locksmith near me".

Be there first. The dancing can wait.

You can't buy your way onto the Google map.

Google's own help page: "there's no way to request or pay for a better local ranking on Google."

Ads put you at the top today.
The map takes months of steady work.

Run both. Start the slow one first.

Fifteen years in business won't hold your spot on Google.

Google wants the best answer right now.

Plumber in Rockingham. Same website since 2014. Last review in 2019.

The new bloke asks every customer for one.

A 15-year gym card won't make you fit either.
